blind.description: A low floor-mounted lever consisting of a rectangular stone brick base, a metal/bronze top plate secured with corner bolts and featuring a central slot, and a metal lever arm with a spherical knob handle tilted to one side. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with clean hand-painted textures; no floating shards, cracks, or melted artifacts. The underside sits flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A rectangular plate oriented vertically in view, bordered with rounded bolt heads at the four corners, containing a central narrow slot through which a round-handled lever rod extends toward the bottom.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/3 the height of the figure (around 1.5 to 2 ft tall to the top of the handle) and about 1/4 the figure's height in width and length.

notes: Base footprint is slightly elongated compared to catalog proportions, but reads clearly at table distance
